title: Replace generated image assets with warm editorial palette and update frontend references

requirements.summary: Recolor the generated header wordmark and feed hero images to a warm neutral editorial palette and update the frontend to reference the new filenames.
acceptanceCriteria: The header wordmark image no longer contains prominent blue/light-blue colors and visually matches a warm editorial palette.
The feed page hero illustration no longer contains prominent blue/light-blue colors and visually matches a warm editorial palette.
The frontend references the updated image filenames under frontend/public/assets/generated and both images render correctly in the UI (no broken image links).

file_operations.description: Add the recolored warm-neutral editorial wordmark image asset (replacing blue/light-blue tones) as a static file at frontend/public/assets/generated/story-ink-wordmark-warm.dim_512x128.png.
Add the recolored warm-neutral editorial hero illustration asset (replacing blue/light-blue tones) as a static file at frontend/public/assets/generated/paper-stories-hero-warm.dim_1400x400.png.

Update the header wordmark source to reference the new static asset filename frontend/public/assets/generated/story-ink-wordmark-warm.dim_512x128.png so the logo renders with the warm editorial palette.

Update the feed hero source to reference the new static asset filename frontend/public/assets/generated/paper-stories-hero-warm.dim_1400x400.png so the hero image renders with the warm editorial palette.
